description: Délimitation géographique du port du masque obligatoire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Grenoble. In view of the health situation of our territory, wearing masks becomes mandatory in the hyper center of Grenoble. This dataset geographically delimits the area where the mask is mandatory and or it does not. For more information, please refer to. Coverage: Ville de Grenoble. The portal shows the English title as "Geographical delimitation of the wearing of the mandatory mask" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Grenoble. Its keywords include covid, hypercentre, masque. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
